001.title: Shevchenko: exactly the division it deserves
001.subject: Andriy Shevchenko

sequences.story: A cartoon reporter asks a caricature of Shevchenko for his verdict. He points to a cosy armchair with slippers, marked League B. Gag: the reporter sits, the chair sighs happily. Twist: a tag under the seat reads Seeding pot: pending.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon reporter; caricature of Shevchenko

sequences.story: A cartoon team hugs a giant football and passes it politely, after you, no, after you, while a scoreboard shows 73%. Gag: nobody shoots. Twist: a cartoon striker in a rival shirt strolls past with a tiny spare ball and scores, and the scoreboard flips to 0-3.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon teams; no real player caricature

sequences.story: A caricature of Shevchenko hands a cartoon Yamal a trophy. His shelf already holds three shiny cups. Gag: Yamal makes room with a polite nod. Twist: the only other item on the shelf is a sticky note reading Ukraine: 7 points, and Yamal hands it back.
sequences.characters: caricature of Shevchenko; caricature of Lamine Yamal

002.title: The VHS tape that bought Shevchenko
002.subject: Andriy Shevchenko

sequences.story: A cartoon scout dozes in an armchair at home beside a giant video tape on a small TV. Gag: he presses play with his toe and tiny cartoon players wave from the screen. Twist: he gives a thumbs-up, then a sticky note on the tape reads Be kind, rewind.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon scout

sequences.story: A caricature of Shevchenko lifts a golden ball trophy next to a giant video tape in a gold frame. Gag: he kisses the tape. Twist: the tape ejects a tiny ticket reading 24 goals.
sequences.characters: caricature of Shevchenko

sequences.story: A cartoon coach hands a caricature of Ronaldo a fluffy pillow and a sign saying Rotation. Gag: Ronaldo lies on the bench with eyes wide open, doing sit-ups on the pillow. Twist: a far-away whistle blows and he springs up already in full kit.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon coach; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo

sequences.story: A cartoon Al Ahli coach builds a wall against a caricature of Ronaldo's free kick: ten tiny defenders with umbrellas. Gag: nobody looks at the ball, they all look at the sky. Twist: the wall is really stacked water bottles, a nod to the water plant he backs.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon coach and defenders; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo

sequences.story: Cartoon fans hold a giant banner reading Thank you, captain. A caricature of Ronaldo hands his shirt and armband to a cartoon kit man, who stamps them Returned. Twist: the scoreboard behind them flashes 4-1 and the kit man quietly hands the armband back.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon fans and kit man; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo

004.title: Ronaldo's red card and the own goal debate
004.subject: Cristiano Ronaldo

sequences.story: A cartoon trophy cabinet is so full that its door is held shut by a single chair. A caricature of Ronaldo opens it and a flood of cups pours out. Twist: the last item is a tiny envelope marked Shortlist, and he puts the chair back, gently.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon cabinet; caricature of Cristiano Ronaldo

sequences.story: A cartoon principal writes EXPELLED on a blackboard. A caricature of Ronaldo sits down on a school chair very gently, as if it might bite. Twist: the principal slides over a notebook and asks for an autograph.

006.subject: Fabio Cannavaro

sequences.story: A cartoon referee raises a yellow card in front of a caricature of Kaka. Gag: the referee raises a second yellow right after, and a stopwatch behind them shows only 18 minutes. Twist: Kaka checks his wristwatch, nods and strolls off quickly.

010.title: Benzema: landslide, then a kart joke
010.subject: Karim Benzema

sequences.characters: generic cartoon phone; caricature of Karim Benzema

sequences.story: A cartoon go-kart labelled Giroud and a Formula One car labelled Benzema line up on a grid. Gag: the F1 car puts on tiny sunglasses. Twist: the lights turn green, both drivers hold up phones to stream it, and the finish line is an Instagram live button.

sequences.characters: caricature Messi (short hair, low centre of gravity); generic cartoon referee; generic cartoon shop owner

sequences.story: A cartoon office has a revolving door that spins three coaches out in three different tracksuits. A caricature Messi sits at the HR desk and hands the next coach a name badge, saying, try not to get comfy. The badge is a sticker that peels off by itself.
sequences.characters: caricature Messi; generic cartoon coaches (no real people); generic cartoon receptionist

sequences.characters: caricature Figo; generic cartoon ballot box with a face

sequences.characters: caricature Figo; generic cartoon coach in a scarf; no real people

sequences.characters: caricature Figo; generic cartoon kit man; no real people

sequences.story: A cartoon retirement party has balloons and a cake that reads goodbye Luka. A caricature Modric walks in, slices the cake, and passes a piece to every guest with the outside of his boot. Then he leaves for training, and the banner quietly flips to see you tomorrow.
sequences.characters: caricature Modric (small, neat midfielder); generic cartoon party guests; no real people

sequences.characters: caricature Modric; generic cartoon rival in a numbered shirt; no real people

sequences.characters: caricature Modric; generic cartoon calendar with a face; no real people

sequences.story: A cartoon scoreboard flips to England 7, Croatia 0 and starts to smoke. A caricature Modric hands the scoreboard a tiny apology card. The scoreboard reads it, sniffs, and flips back to 0-0 out of pity.
sequences.characters: caricature Modric; generic cartoon scoreboard with a face; no real people

sequences.story: A cartoon boardroom has a suit on a hanger labelled administration. A caricature Modric tries it on and it fits perfectly, except the shoes, which are football boots. He shrugs, and the pocket sticker reads still playing.
sequences.characters: caricature Modric; generic cartoon boardroom staff; no real people

sequences.story: A cartoon stopwatch counts up to ninety while younger cartoon midfielders fall over like dominoes. A caricature Modric jogs on, then asks, is that all? He politely hands the stopwatch to the last tired rookie to hold.
sequences.characters: caricature Modric; generic cartoon midfielders; no real people

sequences.story: A cartoon pundit in a studio chair stares into a crystal ball that shows a tiny trophy. Gag: the ball fills with a chart pointing downward. Twist: the crystal ball cracks and the pundit gives a confident thumbs-up anyway.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon pundit

sequences.story: A cartoon pundit holds a storybook open on a hill. Gag: a tiny fox in a crown pops out of the book and does a victory dance. Twist: the pundit closes the book, whispering, and the fox waves from the cover.
sequences.characters: generic cartoon pundit; cartoon fox with a crown

sequences.characters: caricature Owen in a striker's kit; generic cartoon rival with a sash; no real people

sequences.characters: caricature Owen; generic cartoon striker; no real people

sequences.story: A cartoon racecourse has a horse trotting in eighth, wearing a tiny cap. A caricature Owen whispers advice to it. The horse tips its cap and says it was a yard off the pace, and is also available for punditry.
sequences.characters: caricature Owen; generic cartoon horse with a cap; no real people

sequences.characters: Caricature of Pavel Nedvěd with long blond mane (no photo); generic cartoon fans
